_note: Blessed gate files that no control in rule-enforcement-map.json names yet. Created 2026-08-15 when ops/enforcement-coverage-check.py first measured this: 21 of 40 blessed gates were invisible to the coverage map, which is why rule 4a53ff82 read 'unbuilt' while hooks/canonical-edit-gate.py was already enforcing it. A NEW orphan fails the check immediately; these are the recorded debt. The debt may only SHRINK — the check fails if an entry here has since been mapped, or names a gate that no longer exists.
_how_to_clear_one: Add a control to control_catalog naming the file, then point every rule it actually enforces at that control and set their enforcement_class accordingly. Then delete the entry here. ops/rule-enforcement-map-check.py enforces that category and enforcement_class agree.
_shared_helpers: Some entries are not gates at all: they are modules imported BY gates, blessed so tampering stays detectable, denying nothing on their own. They are listed rather than silently filtered, because a silent filter is how a real gate gets excluded by accident.
